question: What happens to my pension if I die before or after I retire?

nuggets.text: Each member designates who receives a refund of contributions if he dies before retirement.
nuggets.quote: Each member shall designate who is to receive a refund of accumulated contributions credited to his account in the event of the death of the member prior to retirement.

nuggets.text: If a member dies in service, a retirement allowance goes to a designated surviving spouse, minor child or parent.
nuggets.quote: a retirement allowance shall be paid to the person or persons designated as provided in subsection A of this section if the person is the member's (i) surviving spouse, (ii) minor child, or (iii) parent(s).

nuggets.text: Without a designation, the refund goes first to the spouse.
nuggets.quote: First, to the spouse of the member;

nuggets.text: A death in service from a cause compensable under workers' compensation gives the surviving spouse an allowance.
nuggets.quote: If a member dies in service from a cause compensable under the Virginia Workers' Compensation Act (§ 65.2-100 et seq.), a retirement allowance shall be paid to the member's surviving spouse.
